text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each tick is a run date in one of the three subsets. Coldest 5% and most showery 5% come from the ensemble's control member only; the largest-error subset comes from GAM-K's own errors. Showery and largest-error days are the union over the six substations.'
text.tspan: Each tick is a run date in one of the three subsets. Coldest 5% and most showery 5% come from
the ensemble's control member only; the largest-error subset comes from GAM-K's own errors.
Showery and largest-error days are the union over the six substations.
